title: Unreleased mask encode optimization, 2026-09-08
before_after_method: Same saved inputs and application source. Published-ultrafast medians are from the previous same-day run, not interleaved with optimized runs. The current optimized-versus-faster comparison uses six balanced fresh-process rounds per case on each host. Warmups and diagnostics excluded.

apple_m2.method: One excluded fresh-process warmup per case/backend, then alternating backend and case order. No timing-based exclusions. Imports and input file loading are excluded; Validator construction/update, compute_metrics(extended=True), F1/IoU and cleanup are included. Separate extended-summary curve diagnostics are excluded. Whole-host telemetry includes worker startup and serialization.

input_provenance.image_selection: First N val2017 image IDs in ascending numeric order; no exclusions
input_provenance.annotation_policy: Unmodified D-FINE-seg Loader: crowds omitted, polygons rasterized; Validator does not receive original COCO area/iscrowd fields
